title: Composite internal module pullback oplax maps are the specified adjunction mates
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and use the small pro-étale sites small relative to module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and also write $R_T$ for its reconstructed section-ring sheaf. Let $E_T:\operatorname{Mod}_{R_T}(\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\operatorname{Ab}))\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ be the fixed equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Use the specified operations and adjunctions of [def-pd-section-module-operations-data], internal relative tensors [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor] and sectionwise sheafified balanced tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $F=f^*_{\rm Ab}$, $G=f_*^{\rm Ab}$ and $v$ for the unit of the abelian adjunction. Give $F$ its actual oplax structure mate to the actual lax structure of $G$ [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-monoidal]. Put $L_{\rm int}=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_f}\operatorname{mapMod}(F)$ [def-sfb-module-upper-star] and $P_{\rm int}=f_{*,\rm int}$ [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. Let $\Phi$ and $u$ be the Hom bijections and unit of their specified composite module adjunction [def-sfb-module-upper-lower-adjunction]. Let $m^{\rm int}_{H,K}:P_{\rm int}H\otimes_{R_Y}P_{\rm int}K\to P_{\rm int}(H\otimes_{R_X}K)$ be the map induced by the actual abelian direct-image lax pairing and balancing, and $e^{\rm int}:R_Y\to P_{\rm int}R_X$ its unit. Let $d_{M,N}$ and $d_0$ be the actual composite oplax maps on $L_{\rm int}$: the relative-tensor descent of the ambient oplax maps of $F$, followed by the extension-of-scalars tensor and unit maps, with scalar insertion and transposition as in [def-sfb-modobj-extend-restrict-adjunction]. Then for all internal $R_Y$-modules $M,N$ one has
$$\Phi(d_{M,N})=m^{\rm int}_{L_{\rm int}M,L_{\rm int}N}\circ(u_M\otimes u_N),\qquad \Phi(d_0)=e^{\rm int}.$$
In particular the stipulated composite maps equal the oplax mates for the specified module adjunction [lem-sfb-adjunction-oplax-mate]; they are not merely arbitrary isomorphisms with those endpoints.

proof.text: Reuse internalPullOplax_eq_canonical from the existing normalized pro-etale section-module functor construction. It identifies the full adjunction-mate oplax structure internalPullOplax with the actual composite monoidal_upperStar.toOplaxMonoidal. Its proof first identifies internalPushLax with canonicalInternalPush by uniqueness of the pure-tensor normalization, and then applies laxMonoidalEquivOplaxMonoidal.apply_symm_apply. Rewriting by this equality changes both stipulated tensor and unit maps to the corresponding maps of the specified adjunction mate.

By the definition of leftAdjointOplaxMonoidal, the rewritten tensor map is the inverse Hom image of the tensor of the two module units followed by internalPushLax.mu, and the rewritten unit map is the inverse Hom image of internalPushLax.epsilon. Apply the forward Hom equivalence to each inverse image and use Equiv.apply_symm_apply. Introduce the two tensor variables and combine their identity with the unit identity by And.intro.
